chunks.text: A Gulf Today column asks if the public is being told the truth about recent tech outages. It says the US grounded all departing flights, only the second time since the September 11 attacks. Microsoft was down for nearly 24 hours, weeks after announcing 60,000 job cuts, the column says. Several American banks went down, and Apple and the National Security Agency's internal network had brief outages. One cyber insider says the number of reports hasn't changed, only the newsworthiness threshold. The columnist writes that whatever company comms teams say, things are clearly not fine. For Gulf businesses and governments running more services in the cloud, how outages get explained to the public is one to watch.
